Dead Tiefling is a corpse in the Blighted Village next to  Lump the Enlightened.

Involvement

Act One

If the party commune with the tiefling using  Speak with Dead and pass a  DC 5 Perception Check, they learn that the corpse was torn open by huge hands, presumably by Lump and his companions.

The tiefling claims to be a friend of  Zorru. The ogres state that she came from the east calling for  Yul. She reveals that she arrived in the Blighted Village because she saw gith.  Lae'zel may comment that she must have been quick of foot to avoid gith hunters.

Speak with Dead

Dead Tiefling can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Who did this to you?
    • Dead Tiefling
      Ogres... hungry... bloodied... screams.
  • Where are you from?
    • Dead Tiefling
      Elturel... Zorru... friend...
  • What brought you to the village?
    • Dead Tiefling
      Strange warriors... gold skin... silver blades...
      • Where did you see those warriors?
        • Dead Tiefling
          Mountains... road... gate...
      • You saw githyanki. Where were they?
        • Dead Tiefling
          Mountains... road... gate...
  • Anything of value you happen to have?
    • Dead Tiefling
      True sight... no... coin...
